fichas.title: Stair regulations and dimensional limits
fichas.summary: The page presents regulatory stair categories and a table of finished dimensions for residential and other buildings. It also gives limits on travel distance to a legally essential stairway and design requirements for landings, stair pitch, and escape routes.

fichas.title: Stair inclines and clearance profiles
fichas.summary: Diagrams describe stair, ramp, and ladder inclines and identify clearance-profile limits around stair flights, walls, handrails, balustrades, ceilings, and stringers. A nearby explanatory passage gives the preferred stair pitch and the stride-length formula for coordinating riser and tread.

dimensions.label: Preferred stair pitch
dimensions.context: The text identifies this as the physiologically best stair pitch for use of climbing effort.
dimensions.ocr_raw: the best use of 'climbing effort' is at a stair pitch of 30°

dimensions.label: Riser-to-tread ratio
dimensions.context: Preferred ratio of riser (r) to tread (t), printed as 17/29.
dimensions.ocr_raw: a ratio of riser (r) to tread (t) of 17/29

dimensions.label: Adult stride length
dimensions.context: Approximate stride length used to determine a suitable stair pitch.
dimensions.ocr_raw: stride length of an adult (approx. 59–65 cm)

dimensions.label: Stride-length formula
dimensions.context: The printed formula is 2r + t = 59–65 cm; the coefficient is not a measured dimension.
dimensions.ocr_raw: this formula applies: 2 r + t = 59–65 cm.

dimensions.label: Minimum side-mounted handrail clearance from wall
dimensions.context: Side-mounted handrail spaced from the wall.

dimensions.context: Clearance profile diagram; associated with the vertical stair-clearance dimension.

fichas.title: Stair layouts, landings, and transport clearances
fichas.summary: The illustrated examples compare the plan areas of stairs with and without landings and show clearances for furniture transport, stretcher carrying, and a spiral staircase. The text notes that landings add to the area of a single-flight stair and that legally essential stairways require landings at the stated storey height.

dimensions.label: Storey height requiring landings in legally essential stairways
dimensions.context: The text states that stairs with landings are required in legally essential stairways at this storey height or greater.
dimensions.ocr_raw: Stairs with landings are required in legally essential stairways with a storey height of ≥2.75 m.
